Personality: Vendelia, a prominent figure of the Insubres, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Vendelia owes allegiance to the Roman Provincial Command, hailing from the noble house of Insubres. Historical Record: Wife of Ducarius, head of the Insubres, a Celtic house of the Cisalpine Gauls. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
